city.name: Key Biscayne
city.blurb: Miami's quiet island — pay the toll, skip the crowds.

editorial_intro: Key Biscayne is a quiet island suburb, not a party beach, and most of it is residential. The Rickenbacker Causeway is the only road in, so sunny weekends and holidays back traffic up for miles; go early on a weekday. Bill Baggs Cape Florida and Crandon Park charge their own entry and parking, and the lots fill by late morning on nice days.

city_events.name: Sargassum season
city_events.blurb: Miami-Dade's sargassum season runs from March through October, and the island's ocean-facing beaches can get heavy seaweed in some years.

city_events.name: Rainy season
city_events.blurb: From mid-May to mid-October, expect heat, humidity and frequent thunderstorms. Plan beach time for the morning.

city_events.name: Summer weekend crowds
city_events.blurb: On summer weekends, Crandon Park's 3,000 parking spaces fill up and shaded picnic tables go early. Come on a weekday or arrive early.

city_events.name: Fourth of July Parade
city_events.blurb: Held every July 4 since 1959, the morning parade runs along Crandon Boulevard, the island's main road.

city_events.name: Hurricane season peak
city_events.blurb: Most Atlantic hurricane activity comes between mid-August and mid-October. The Rickenbacker Causeway is the only road on and off the island.

city_events.name: Winter weekdays
city_events.blurb: Crandon Park Beach is much less crowded in winter, and on weekdays you may have long stretches of sand nearly to yourself.
